Name: TC_TIME_009(security): Verify access control for Time Employee Reports
Precondition:
Pre-conditions: 1. Access the OrangeHRM portal. 2. Have two sets of
credentials: one Admin (to identify the report URL) and one Regular
Employee (to attempt unauthorized access). 3. Identify a valid report URL
(e.g., .../web/index.php/time/displayEmployeeReport/reportId/1).

Requirements:

* The system shall restrict the "Reports" menu visibility based on the
user's role.

* The system shall implement server-side validation to block direct URL
access to reports for unauthorized users.
Objective:
Objective: This test case verifies that the "Time Employee Reports" are
restricted to authorized personnel only. It ensures that a user with a
"Regular Employee" role cannot access or view report data that belongs to
other employees or the entire organization.
Step: Login in the platform as a Regular Employee
Expected Result: * Website working properly and redirected to the user dashboard.
